name: edge-alignment
whatItDemonstrates: A single-thumb slider with thumbAlignment='edge' so the thumb's edge (rather than its center) aligns with the control edge when the value is at min or max.
stateManaged: uncontrolled — defaultValue={25} on Slider.Root, no value state in the demo

name: hero
whatItDemonstrates: The minimal single-thumb slider composition (Root > Control > Track > Indicator + Thumb) at a default value, used as the page hero.
stateManaged: uncontrolled — defaultValue={25} on Slider.Root, no value state in the demo

name: marks
whatItDemonstrates: User-rendered tick marks and value labels positioned along the track as a percentage of the min-max value range.
stateManaged: uncontrolled — defaultValue={40} on Slider.Root, no value state in the demo
nonTrivialInteractions: tick marks are plain aria-hidden divs rendered inside Slider.Track, positioned with left: valueToPercent(mark)%
a separate aria-hidden label row below the control renders each mark's numeric value using the same valueToPercent percentage math
marks are purely visual: no step prop is set, so thumb granularity is unaffected (marks are independent of the value's granularity)

name: range-slider
whatItDemonstrates: A two-thumb range slider: an array defaultValue with one Slider.Thumb per value, each bound to its value via an explicit index prop.
stateManaged: uncontrolled — defaultValue={[25, 45]} on Slider.Root, no value state in the demo
nonTrivialInteractions: two thumbs bound to values[0] and values[1] via explicit index={0} / index={1} props
per-thumb aria-labels ('Minimum value' / 'Maximum value') distinguish the thumbs for assistive tech

name: steps
whatItDemonstrates: A labeled slider with a visible Slider.Value that snaps to step={100} increments between min={100} and max={900}, with largeStep={200} for Page Up/Page Down and Shift+Arrow keys.
stateManaged: uncontrolled — defaultValue={400} on Slider.Root, no value state in the demo
nonTrivialInteractions: value snapping to multiples of step={100} within [min={100}, max={900}]
largeStep={200} governs the increment for Page Up/Page Down and Shift+Arrow Up/Arrow Down
Slider.Label provides the accessible name so the Thumb needs no aria-label, and Slider.Value renders the formatted current value with no children render function
discrepancies: Label copy differs between variants (styling-independent content divergence): the tailwind variant's Slider.Label reads 'Playback speed' at `docs/src/app/(docs)/react/components/slider/demos/steps/tailwind/index.tsx:13-15` while the css-modules variant reads 'Font weight' at `docs/src/app/(docs)/react/components/slider/demos/steps/css-modules/index.tsx:14`. Component structure, props, and behavior are otherwise identical.

name: vertical
whatItDemonstrates: A vertical slider built by setting orientation='vertical' on Slider.Root, with layout sized via data-orientation attribute selectors.
stateManaged: uncontrolled — defaultValue={35} on Slider.Root, no value state in the demo
nonTrivialInteractions: Control and Track dimensions are driven by data-[orientation=vertical] selectors rather than separate markup, exercising the data-orientation attribute the component exposes
vertical proportions: Control is h-32 px-3 and Track is h-full w-1 (transposed from the horizontal demos)
